title: Take-up Rates for Recommended Adult Vaccinations
what_it_is: Take-up Rates for Recommended Adult Vaccinations

sections.label: National Adult Immunisation Schedule and MediSave
sections.summary: MOH set up the National Adult Immunisation Schedule in November 2017, and MediSave may pay for its vaccinations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) established the National Adult Immunisation Schedule (NAIS) in November 2017 to provide guidance on important vaccinations for adults.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MediSave may be used to pay for NAIS vaccinations.

sections.label: NAIS take-up and planned subsidies
sections.summary: NAIS guides doctors' recommendations, take-up is rising, and subsidies are targeted before end-2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: NAIS also serves as a guide for doctors on the vaccinations they should recommend their patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have been observing a steady increase in the take-up of NAIS vaccinations since its introduction, with more using MediSave to pay for them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Around 24% of adults between 65 and 79 take up the vaccination according to the National Health population survey 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In 2017, 39,000 adults use MediSave for flu vaccination.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In July 2019, the HealthySG Taskforce recommended that to further boost adult vaccination rates, subsidies should be provided to help Singaporeans pay for NAIS recommended vaccinations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The subsidies are targeted to be rolled out before the end of 2020 and details will be announced at a later date.

sections.label: Income groups and vaccination cost
sections.summary: MOH does not track vaccination rates by income group but recognises cost may hinder lower-income groups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: MOH does not track data on vaccination rates across the different income groups, but we recognise that cost may pose a difficulty for those in the lower-income group.
